ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) pixel distribution localized in linear and punctate clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Macro-level dark field with high-contrast white linear clusters concentrated in the upper-right quadrant and lower-left quadrant; high-intensity punctate stippling scattered across the lower central vertical axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, approximately 45-degree U-shaped central depression dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregularity; numerous jagged indentations exceeding 15 pixels in depth, particularly on the right distal lobe and the immediate left of the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge path with broad convex lateral terminals.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters visible at the extreme lateral tips (far left and far right) and sparse white stippling in the lower-central fluke region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive sets of parallel white linear marks; distinct grouping of 6-7 parallel arcs in the upper right lobe and 5-6 diagonal parallel lines in the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe rake-mark scarring across the ventral surface; significant irregular tissue loss/notching along the entire trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast skeletal-like white marking pattern concentrated on the far upper-right trailing edge.
